ideas.pitch: An agentic engineering lifecycle platform that automatically captures codebase context and team tribal knowledge through Git and Slack hooks, then acts as an interactive mentor when new developers join.
ideas.title: OnboardAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting a pain familiar to developers and engineering teams, matching the success pattern of devflow which won 1st place by solving developer knowledge retention.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous debugging agent that intercepts live runtime errors from production logs or test runs, traces the root cause across multi-file codebases, generates a fix, and opens a fully tested PR draft.
ideas.title: Error2PR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering and direct workflow automation, mirroring the winning strategy of bobthebuilder at the IBM Bob Dev Day Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router that uses kNN over an exemplar index and LLM-judge writeback to dynamically route incoming agent tool calls to the cheapest and most accurate model.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on high-performance infrastructure optimization and cost reduction, leveraging the winning approach of darwin-router which secured first prize by solving efficient agent routing.

ideas.pitch: A federated Model Context Protocol server integrated on a local Kubernetes cluster that securely queries clinical databases and EHR systems to assist medical professionals with diagnostic data retrieval.
ideas.title: Clinical-MCP Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced enterprise protocols (MCP) with domain-specific utility, following the winning pattern of mcp-clinical-platform in building complex agentic interoperability.

ideas.pitch: A TOON-native auto-embedding and RAG toolkit built specifically for MariaDB that empowers autonomous AI agents to query relational databases with semantic context out of the box.
ideas.title: AutoMariaDB RAG Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a plug-and-play developer utility with clear benchmarks, echoing the success of seamless-rag which won 2nd place at the MariaDB Hackathon.
